title: Word Detectives: Consonant Digraphs
description: Learn sh, ch, th, wh, and ph; read and match words; find final digraphs; sort words; and read short decodable sentences.
learningFocus: Recognize common consonant digraphs as two letters making one sound and use them to read one-syllable words and short sentences.
adultGuidance: Model the sound made by each digraph rather than naming its letters, and help your child cover the digraph, read the rest of a word, then add the digraph sound. Page 2 matches ship, shell, chick, chop, thumb, and whip; Page 3 endings are fish-sh, dish-sh, bench-ch, lunch-ch, bath-th, moth-th; Page 4 sorts shop/shut, chip/chop, thin/thick, whip/whack, graph/Phil; Page 5 sentence-picture matches are fish in a dish, chick on a bench, ship on sand, and chick in a shop.
